LILYGO T-Display V1.1 (ESP32, 1.14 inch TFT) in two 1x12 female headers, powered through its USB-C socket
IO27/IO26/IO25/IO33/IO32: countdown LEDs, IO13: servo, IO38/IO37: start/reset buttons (input only)
3.3 V logic: the buttons switch 3V3; IO12, IO15, IO2 (strapping pins) stay free
Spare: IO2, IO12, IO15, IO17, IO21, IO22, IO36, IO39
Servo at the module's 5V pin (USB behind its 1N5819); C1 buffers its start-up peaks
Nets with the same name are connected (labels and power flags).
Variant ESP32 (D-13): the SMD variant with a T-Display instead of the Nano;
yellow-green LEDs (D-14) – the 3.3 V outputs do not drive emerald green reliably.
R8 + R9: base load, keeps USB power banks on (D-8).
